name: By The Dutch Old Genever
base_ingredient: Malt wine from rye, corn and malted barley (high malt wine content)
production: Pot-still distillation of rye/corn/malt wash to ~13% (ruwnat)
Third distillation in column still with juniper to 48% (maltwine)
Portions redistilled with botanicals, without botanicals and with juniper; four parts blended
history: 1942 | Date of the old recipe it is based on
2007 | Genever becomes a protected spirit of Holland
2016 | Gold at LA International Spirits Competition and Global Gin Masters
notes: AOC Old Genever designation. Pale light-yellow colour. Also 75 cl for some markets.
